messages:
alex: kicked off max_batch_tokens autoscale + jittered arrival backoff experiments for mosaik-14b (q4f) across h100-us-west, h100-eu-west, a100-us-east.

sam: autoscale how? perf-bot: step-based policy with hysteresis + warmup probe. scale up when avg_batch_fill>0.7 for 30s, down when <0.4 for 60s. jittered ingress backoff adds 5-15ms random offset to arrival slew.

alex: also tested kernel warmup: inject 2 short "priming" requests per new worker to trigger fused kernels and allocate KV caches before real traffic.

maria: results? p50/p95/p99 + t/s per GPU.

alex: best config: autoscale step=+1/-1 nodes, hysteresis=30/60s, jitter=8-12ms, warmup=2 probes, base_window=12ms.

h100/us-west: p50=11ms p95=40ms p99=95ms tokens/s/GPU=240k
h100/eu-west: p50=16ms p95=62ms p99=140ms tokens/s/GPU=195k
a100/us-east: p50=29ms p95=100ms p99=230ms tokens/s/GPU=138k

sam: warmup impact?

alex: warmup reduced cold-start p99 by ~35% on h100 and ~20% on a100. overall p99 improved ~8% under churny pool scaling.

taylor: jittered backoff tradeoffs?

alex: jitter prevented synchronized bursts that caused kernel thrashing; p99 improved ~10% versus no-jitter, tokens/s down ~3%.

maria: kernel selector notes?

alex: h100 switches into cutlass-fused path once worker has seen >3 large batches; warmup helps hit that state faster. a100 still sometimes chooses legacy path due to seq variance; attached selector logs.

jiang-bot: quant regression check: q4f vs fp16 on 1k QA samples: minor diffs, BLEU stable, mark pass.

eng-runtime: can you share the ldms + warmup trace? alex: uploaded: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/bench/1851234567-autoscale

maria: capacity guidance?

alex: recommendation: enable autoscale with hysteresis + warmup for hosted mosaik-14b; sizing multiplier: h100 1.12x naive, a100 1.5x. for Dedicated, prefer proactive warmup on scale events.

sam: any failure modes observed?

alex: transient overload when autoscale reacted slowly to sudden long-tail spike; mitigations: shorten upscale hysteresis to 15s under high tail ratio, and pre-scale based on routing predictions.

maria: action items?

alex: (1) enable autoscale canary for h100/us-west with warmup+jitter tomorrow 07:00 UTC, (2) eng-runtime to review selector logs for a100 fallback, (3) add warmup probe to onboarding checklist.

perf-bot: queued bench job 1851234567-autoscale (est 8h).

maria: +1. thanks :thumbsup:
